candidates.title: Travels Bus Crashes Into Hotel in Shamshabad, One Killed and Over 50 Injured
candidates.excerpt: A private travels bus crashed into the Balaji Bhavan hotel in Shamshabad while reportedly attempting to avoid an uncontrolled container vehicle, leaving one person dead and more than 50 others injured.

candidates.title: Rain brings relief to farmers in Telangana’s Karimnagar
candidates.excerpt: Overnight rain caused waterlogging in Kothagattu, Gollapalli and neighbouring villages in Shankarapatnam mandal

candidates.title: After rains, HYDRAA inspects waterlogged areas in Secunderabad
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad: A day after heavy rains, Hyderabad Disaster Response and Assets Protection Agency (HYDAA) officials inspected waterlogged areas in Secunderabad on Monday, September 14. The agency cleared drains and pumped out floodwater to prevent water stagnation. candidates.title: HYDRAA tackles waterlogging after heavy rain in Secunderabad
candidates.excerpt: Heavy rain inundated several parts of Secunderabad on Sunday night, flooding roads and low-lying areas. HYDRAA and DRF teams cleared drains, removed garbage and pumped out water, while Hussain Sagar gates were opened to prevent flooding in upper areas

candidates.title: Karimnagar man killed as bus crashes into hotel in Shamshabad
candidates.excerpt: A 34-year-old Karimnagar man heading to Hyderabad airport to return to Saudi Arabia was killed after a speeding private travel bus lost control and crashed into a hotel at Shamshabad on Monday. Several others were injured and shifted to hospitals

candidates.title: Telangana Minister offers support to family of deceased BRS leader
candidates.excerpt: Minister Adluri Lakshman Kumar extends helping hand to family of former BRS mandal president; provides ₹50,000 assistance and assures outsourcing job for widow

candidates.title: Backward Classes group raises concern over challenges to caste census
candidates.excerpt: National BC Dal president Dundra Kumaraswamy said variations arising from regional nomenclature, sub-caste identities, local usage, pronunciation and spelling could result in multiple entries for what may, in social terms, represent the same community

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Pregnant woman allegedly strangled to death by husband in Alwal
candidates.excerpt: A six-month-pregnant woman was allegedly strangled to death by her husband following a dispute at Suryanagar in Alwal. Police said the man, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, initially claimed she had slipped in the bathroom before reportedly confessing.

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Man dies after clash over Ganesh idol purchase in Pocharam
candidates.excerpt: A 34-year-old man died allegedly after a clash between Ganesh idol buyers and sellers in Pocharam IT Corridor police limits. His relatives and friends later protested on the Warangal-Hyderabad National Highway, demanding stringent action against five alleged attackers.
